changelog:
NEW: Festive Home collections, Christmas countdown and seasonal picks.
IMPROVED: Movie suggestions with visible reasons, meaningful viewing and saved-title seeds, runtime/year filters and Not for me feedback.
NEW: Downloads from supported direct sources, with an unmetered queue and a separate offline player. Some sources remain streaming-only.
IMPROVED: Searchable Settings, AI & Voice and Downloads controls, native audio/subtitle preferences and accurate onboarding.
IMPROVED: Catalog-backed AI actions for comparison, library, resume and download review. Cloud AI requires sign-in; actions remain reviewable. Phone/tablet and TV interfaces differ.
